items.title: File the Allen County innkeeper's tax return
items.description: The Indiana County Innkeepers Tax Return is filed with the County Treasurer and due on or before the 20th of the month after the tax was collected; a registered business must still file a $0 return. Late returns bear a penalty (the form says the greater of $5 or 10%, the Department of Revenue page says up to 20%) plus interest. Confirm with the county auditor that the county's innkeeper's tax applies to the business, and check the county's current rate: 2026 legislation (HEA 1210) changed the rules for some counties. The county's own page was not individually confirmed; this is the state form's rule.
